title: feat(renmeet): ridge-enter two-seed meet |M|=1 vars 0
science: Two-seed meeting set on B_12(0) u B_12((2,0,0)) (3203 sites): under kappa the equal-arrival set has 313 sites but the first-meeting set collapses to the singleton {(1,0,0)} at t=3, so the arrival-speed variance is 0 and TIES the unit-cost l1 comparator. Forcing negative: a one-seed roundness gain does not survive as a two-seed variance gap.
